display.purpose: Headings, page titles, and the hero headline only.

action.purpose: Button and link text; the one place the display font crosses into interactive copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase meta text — dates, brand labels, block labels.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in active use; a whisper of lift under every glass card.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Declared but currently unused anywhere in the codebase; reserved for a component that needs stronger lift.

shadows.name: premium
shadows.purpose: Declared but currently unused anywhere in the codebase; reserved for a rare high-emphasis surface.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus color and border transitions.

motion.name: transition-smooth
motion.purpose: Slower easing for larger state changes (e.g. menu blur).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Text-style CTA link used for every action in the site, from the hero to card footers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--color-accent); background: none; border: none; padding: 0.5rem 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The single recurring surface pattern: a frosted, translucent rounded container used for offers, blog posts, brands, and services.
components.html:
Ortopedia en Bétera

Servicio especializado con asesoramiento personalizado.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-card-glass:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-soft); } .ds-card-content { padding: var(--spacing-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--spacing-sm); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--color-primary); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Discount Badge
components.description: The only place Coral Alert appears — a scarce, single-purpose status marker for time-limited offers.
components.css: .ds-badge-discount { position: absolute; top: var(--spacing-md); left: var(--spacing-md); background: var(--color-danger); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Fixed glass header with a live reading-progress bar in Trust Blue along its bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-header { height: var(--header-height); width: 100%; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 100; background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(var(--glass-blur)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(var(--glass-blur)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border); } .ds-header-content { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 2rem; } .ds-logo-img { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-logo-link:hover .ds-logo-img { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-reading-progress { position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 0; width: 40%; height: 2px; background: var(--color-accent); transition: width 0.1s ease-out; }

components.name: Service Disclosure
components.description: Signature component: a glass card that expands in place to reveal service detail via a grid-rows transition, rather than navigating away.
components.css: .ds-service-card { background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); } .ds-service-trigger { width: 100%; padding: var(--spacing-lg); background: none; border: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-service-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--spacing-md); } .ds-service-icon { font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-icon { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-title-wrap { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-service-title { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; } .ds-toggle-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-chevron { color: var(--color-accent); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-service-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
The system reads as a quiet, trustworthy advisor rather than a shop window: absolute black carries authority in headings and the footer, one sky-blue accent stands in for care and guidance on every link and highlight, and everything else recedes into pale sky and white. Cards float as frosted glass — translucent, gently blurred, barely shadowed — so content feels lightly lifted off the page rather than boxed in. There is no ornament competing for attention: no gradients beyond a whisper-soft accent wash, no filled buttons, no heavy iconography.

Density stays comfortable rather than dense: generous section padding (--section-padding: 5rem), wide line lengths capped for readability (max-width: 45ch on subtitles, 65–75ch implied for body copy), and a single accent color kept rare enough that its every appearance reads as "this matters" — a link, a live offer, a call to action.
keyCharacteristics: Absolute black + one trust-blue accent; no secondary hue.
Frosted-glass cards (blur + hairline border + whisper shadow) as the one recurring surface pattern.
Text-style buttons (no fill, no border) that shift from blue to black on hover.
Generous whitespace and capped line lengths over dense information packing.
Rounded, soft geometry throughout (10–32px radii); no sharp corners anywhere.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Trust Blue is the only hue permitted for interactive or emphasis meaning. A second accent color must not be introduced without revising this document; use black, white, or the pale-sky neutrals for everything else.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Display text always runs negative letter-spacing (-0.04em to -0.06em) and near-1.0 line-height; loosened, airy headings are off-brand for this system.

rules.name: The No-Heavy-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a component needs to feel elevated, reach for the glass treatment (blur + hairline border) before reaching for a stronger shadow. A heavy drop shadow is a signal something is off-system.

dos: Do keep Trust Blue as the only accent color; every new interactive or emphasis element reaches for it before any new hue.
Do build new surfaces from the glass-card pattern (blur + hairline border + subtle shadow) rather than introducing a new card treatment.
Do use Outfit for headings and button/action text, Inter for everything else, with tight negative letter-spacing on display text.
Do keep buttons as text-style links with no fill or border; the blue-to-black hover shift is the only state change they need.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or a filled/solid button — both are off-system for this design.
Don't reach for a strong drop shadow; depth comes from glass blur, not shadow weight.
Don't use Coral Alert outside the discount badge context — it's a scarce, single-purpose status color.
Don't use sharp corners; every surface in this system is rounded (10–32px).
